article.story: MISSOULA, Mont. -- — Malik Moore had 20 points in Montana's 81-76 victory against Northern Arizona on Thursday night. Moore also contributed five assists for the Grizzlies (10-6, 3-0 Big Sky Conference). Brandon Whitney scored 16 points while shooting 5 of 7 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line. Kai Johnson had 12 points and went 5 of 8 from the field (1 for 3 from 3-point range). Jayden Jackson finished with 22 points and seven assists for the Lumberjacks (10-6, 1-2). Trenton McLaughlin added 19 points, four assists and two steals. Monty Bowser finished with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
